description: Client code for connecting to SparkRBackend, including functions for establishing connections, determining Spark submit binary, generating submit arguments, checking Java version, and launching backend processes.

methods.name: connectBackend
methods.description: Establishes a connection to SparkRBackend, reusing existing connection if available.

methods.name: determineSparkSubmitBin
methods.description: Determines the appropriate spark-submit binary name based on OS type.

methods.name: generateSparkSubmitArgs
methods.description: Constructs the command-line arguments for spark-submit, including jars, packages, and additional options.

methods.name: checkJavaVersion
methods.description: Checks the installed Java version against Spark requirements.

methods.name: launchBackend
methods.description: Launches the Spark backend process using spark-submit with specified arguments and options.
